facts.title: KeyframeUI: Animated React components for shadcn/ui
facts.description: Animated React components for shadcn/ui, built with Tailwind CSS and Motion. Install a component, or a whole demo, as source with one shadcn CLI command.

research.name: KeyframeUI
research.note: Animated shadcn registry of whole landing sections, each built around one motion idea and installed as source.

effects: Paint Reveal: the pointer paints a second image in with a soft brush and the stroke closes back behind it
Sentence Form: a contact form written as a sentence whose blanks stretch as you type
Keyframe timeline hero that replays the headline, copy and actions animation on a visible track

unverified: No dated changelog or release was found; the site only labels Zeno Progress as New without a date, and the sitemap has no lastmod, so lastUpdated is empty.
No public source repository was found on the site or via GitHub search; component source is only served through the registry at keyframeui.com/r.
Pricing is recorded as free because no pricing page or paid tier was found and every component installs from the public registry.
